full_judgment:
8. The appeal of the accused petitioner before the Sessions Judge, Pirojpur was barred by about 9 months. The accused petitioner did not file any application for condonation of the inordinate delay under section 5 of the Limitation Act by explaining the ordinate delay by offering plausible and acceptable explanation. The learned Sessions Judge, Pirojpur by his order dated 26.4.1997 dismissed the appeal on the ground of limitation. 

 12. The learned Counsel appearing for the accused petitioner has placed before me the impugned judgments passed by the learned Courts below. Admittedly the petitioners appeal before the learned Sessions Judge was barred by 9 months and 19 days, This inordinate delay was not explained by the accused petitioner by offering any possible and acceptable explanation. In such view of the matter, the learned Sessions Judge was perfectly justified in not condoning the inordinate delay for about 9 months and in dismissing the appeal as being helplessly barred by limitation.
